# Threads
> Threads is Meta’s text-first social platform for sharing updates, joining conversations, and connecting with communities using your Instagram account.

Threads lets people post short text updates, photos, videos, and links, follow creators and friends, discover conversations, and manage profiles tied to Instagram. The platform also provides web access for profiles, individual posts, feeds, search, and account settings.

## Core App Pages
- [Threads Home](https://www.threads.com/): Main entry point for browsing Threads and accessing the web app.
- [Log In](https://www.threads.com/login): Sign in to Threads using your Instagram-linked account.
- [Sign Up](https://www.threads.com/signup): Create or activate a Threads presence through Instagram.
- [Search](https://www.threads.com/search): Search for people, profiles, and conversations on Threads.
- [Activity](https://www.threads.com/activity): View notifications, replies, follows, and account activity.
- [Settings](https://www.threads.com/settings): Manage account, privacy, notifications, and app preferences.

## Profiles and Posts
- [Profile Pages](https://www.threads.com/@zuck): Public user profile format showing posts, replies, and follower information.
- [Post Pages](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/CuTvjQZL9MS): Canonical format for individual Threads posts shared on the web.
- [Replies Tab](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/replies): Profile replies view for a user’s responses and conversation activity.
- [Reposts Tab](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/reposts): Profile reposts view for content a user has reshared.
- [Media Tab](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/media): Profile media view for photos and videos shared by a user.

## Feeds and Discovery
- [For You Feed](https://www.threads.com/): Personalized feed of recommended posts and conversations.
- [Following Feed](https://www.threads.com/following): Chronological feed from accounts you follow.
- [Saved Posts](https://www.threads.com/saved): Access posts you have saved for later.
- [Likes](https://www.threads.com/likes): Review posts you have liked on your account.
- [Explore Search](https://www.threads.com/search): Discover trending topics, accounts, and discussions.

## Account and Privacy
- [Account Settings](https://www.threads.com/settings/account): Manage account details and connected profile settings.
- [Privacy Settings](https://www.threads.com/settings/privacy): Control profile visibility, mentions, replies, and interaction permissions.
- [Notifications Settings](https://www.threads.com/settings/notifications): Configure push and in-app notification preferences.
- [Blocked Accounts](https://www.threads.com/settings/privacy/blocked): Review and manage blocked profiles.
- [Muted Accounts](https://www.threads.com/settings/privacy/muted): Manage muted profiles and conversation controls.
- [Hidden Words](https://www.threads.com/settings/privacy/hidden_words): Filter unwanted words, phrases, and offensive replies.

## Help and Support
- [Threads Help Center](https://help.instagram.com/769983657850450): Official help resource for using Threads and troubleshooting issues.
- [Instagram Help Center](https://help.instagram.com/): Broader Meta support documentation relevant to Threads accounts and safety.
- [Privacy and Safety on Threads](https://help.instagram.com/515230437301944): Guidance on privacy, controls, and safety features for Threads.
- [Report Something on Threads](https://help.instagram.com/543533392321986): Instructions for reporting posts, profiles, and abusive behavior.
- [Accessibility Help](https://help.instagram.com/465247226797767): Accessibility information for using Meta products including Threads.

## Policies and Legal
- [Threads Terms of Use](https://help.instagram.com/769983657850450): Terms and usage policies governing access to Threads.
- [Meta Privacy Policy](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy): Privacy policy covering data handling for Instagram and Threads.
- [Meta Privacy Center](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/): Central resource for privacy controls, explanations, and user choices.
- [Community Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119): Rules for acceptable behavior and content across Meta platforms.
- [Data Policy Information](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/?section_id=0-WhatIsThePrivacyPolicy): Overview of how Meta collects and uses information.

## Creators and Publishing
- [Create a Post](https://www.threads.com/intent/post): Start composing a new Threads post from the web.
- [Share a Profile](https://www.threads.com/@zuck): Public profile sharing format for creators and public figures.
- [Share a Post](https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/CuTvjQZL9MS): Public post URL format for sharing conversations externally.
- [Embed and Link Sharing](https://www.threads.com/): Web sharing entry point for distributing Threads content.
- [Instagram Integration](https://www.instagram.com/): Connected identity and account system used to access Threads.

## Meta Ecosystem
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/): Companion platform used for login, identity, and connected social graph.
- [Meta Accounts Center](https://accountscenter.instagram.com/): Manage connected Meta account settings across supported apps.
- [Meta Privacy Center](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/): Privacy controls and explanations across Meta services.
- [Meta Safety Center](https://about.meta.com/actions/safety): Safety resources, policies, and product protections from Meta.
- [Meta Transparency Center](https://transparency.fb.com/): Information about enforcement, integrity, and transparency reporting.
